scope: RoleBindings contract only; existing implementation unchanged

test.newCase: shared Agent keeps application, instance and delimiter-bearing role keys isolated across replacement and restart

assertions: Seven declared keys share the same Agent preset but receive seven different Session IDs.
Four concurrent ensure calls per key issue one native creation command per key.
Application ID, instance ID, role ID and subject absence/presence remain separate, including colon-bearing identifiers.
Replacing one binding preserves only its own prior Session ID; every other record remains unchanged.
A foreign replacement Session ID is rejected as stale without issuing another create command.
Disposal and reconstruction over the retained table preserve each binding and history without new native commands.
limitations: Uses the actual RoleBindings implementation with an in-memory KvTable adapter and a native authority command recorder.
Does not certify real DSH transcript contents, running tasks, durable disk storage, model teaching, permissions or Stop.
No application runtime code, formal 3080 data, screenshot or browser draft payload changed.
